parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optionally limit the number of segments returned. Defaults to 20. The max limit for a single page is 100.

parameters.name: paginationToken
parameters.description:
Optional pagination token for retrieving more results.
List params should not change between consecutive paginated requests (limit is an exception).

parameters.name: creator
parameters.description:
If set, filters the returned segments by the provided creator. This should
be an email associated with a Fullstory account.

name.description: The display name of the segment.

creator.description: The email associated with the Fullstory user who created the segment.

created.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp for when the segment was created. Will not be present for built-in segments.

url.description: URL for the corresponding segment in the Fullstory app.

segments.title: An array of segments as described in the [Get Segment API](../get-segment)

nextPaginationToken.description:
If present, then there are more results which can be retrieved by making another request with this token as the
`pagination_token`.
